headline: Redwood Industries faces customer complaints over packaging defects
body: Several customers reported damaged goods linked to packaging changes at Redwood Industries. The company said it is reviewing its packing process.

headline: Analysts trim outlook for Redwood Industries on softer demand
body: Two analysts lowered their outlook for Redwood Industries, citing softer demand and rising input costs. No change to guidance has been announced.

headline: Redwood Industries publishes annual sustainability report
body: Redwood Industries released its annual sustainability report covering energy use and waste reduction targets. The report was prepared in line with standard reporting guidelines.

headline: Court freezes assets of Redwood Industries amid insolvency petition
body: A court froze assets of Redwood Industries after creditors filed an insolvency petition. Operations continue under court supervision.

headline: Redwood Industries opens new production line in Gdansk
body: Redwood Industries commissioned a new line at its Gdansk site, adding capacity for existing customers. Management said the expansion was funded from operating cash flow.

headline: Redwood Industries appoints new regional sales director
body: Redwood Industries announced a leadership appointment in its sales organization. The company said the change is part of a planned succession.
